en.intro: Preparing an SSC photo or signature starts with the instructions for your own application. This workspace keeps the two image types separate so you can enter the correct dimensions and byte limits without treating an older requirement as current.

name: SSC
notes: Values transcribed from the official CGL 2026 notice; the full PDF text was read via a faithful mirror copy (official ssc.gov.in PDF not directly fetchable from this environment). SSC CHSL 2026 specs appear identical (live photo; signature 10–20 KB, ~6.0 x 2.0 cm) from third-party reporting and the CHSL 2025 notice, but its full 2026 notice could not be read — kept as a single SSC record.

photo_spec.rules: No photo upload. The application module captures a live photograph (webcam or mobile via QR code): good light, plain background, camera at eye level, face fully inside the delineated area, no cap/mask/glasses. Capturing a pre-existing photograph leads to rejection.

signature_spec.rules: Notice body (Para 9.6): about 6.0 cm (width) x 2.0 cm (height). Annexure-IV of the same notice instead states about 4.0 cm (width) x 2.0 cm (height). Blurred or miniature signatures are rejected. Thumb impression allowed for PwD(VH) candidates.

source_title: Notice – Combined Graduate Level Examination, 2026 (F. No. HQ-C11018/1/2026-C-1), Staff Selection Commission

en.intro: Keep your original portrait and signature while preparing images for a UPSC application. Use this page to make separate working copies after reading the relevant notification. No dimensions or file-size limits have been assumed for you.

name: UPSC
notes: 20–300 KB and JPG format confirmed from the official CSE 2026 notice and Examination FAQ; full text read via faithful copies (live upsconline.nic.in instructions page could not be fetched). Pixel ranges and bit-depth quoted by third parties (e.g. 350x350–1000x1000) were NOT found in the notice or FAQ — left null until checked on the live portal.

photo_spec.rules: Both an uploaded photograph AND a live photograph captured in the Common Application Form are required. Photo must be white background, 3/4 full face (top of hair to bottom of chin), candidate name and photo date printed at the bottom, not more than 10 days old from the start of the online application. Appearance must match the photo at Prelims, Mains and Interview. Pixel dimensions are stated only in the portal's application-module instructions (not read); left null.

signature_spec.rules: Sign three times (one below the other) on plain white paper with black ink and upload. Samples of acceptable/non-acceptable photo and signature are shown in the application module.

source_title: Examination Notice No. 05/2026-CSE dated 04.02.2026 (Civil Services Preliminary Examination) and the UPSC Examination Branch official FAQ (Q.11)

en.intro: Prepare your NEET photograph and signature as separate files. The table records the listed bulletin’s formats and size limits; read its live-photo requirements as well, because editing a stored image does not replace that application step. Inspect the downloaded copy before uploading it.

name: NEET
notes: Values from Chapter 3 / Application Procedure of the official bulletin (official CDN timed out; full text read via a faithful copy). Internal inconsistency in the bulletin: thumb impressions stated as 10–200 KB in one item and 50–300 KB in its own section — not used here.

photo_spec.rules: Recent passport-size photograph, colour or black & white, 80% face (without mask) visible including ears, against white background; clearly legible. Scanned photo must be taken after 01 January 2026 and is also pasted on the attendance sheet. A separate LIVE photograph is additionally required at form fill (webcam or mobile via QR code, matched with Aadhaar). Keep 6–8 passport-size and 4–6 postcard-size (4x6 inch) colour photos with white background. Spectacles only if used regularly; polaroid/computer-generated photos not acceptable.

signature_spec.rules: Clearly legible; no ink, paper or dimension rules stated in the bulletin.

source_title: INFORMATION BULLETIN NEET (UG)-2026, National Testing Agency

en.intro: Before editing a JEE Main upload, distinguish its pixel requirements from its file-size allowance. This page provides separate photo and signature controls for those constraints. Enter values from the instructions that apply to your application; the site does not guess them.

name: JEE Main
notes: Values from Step 2 / Application Procedure of the official bulletin (official CDN timed out; full text read via a proxy of the official document). Coaching blogs quoting 3.5x4.5 cm for JEE are not in this bulletin.

photo_spec.rules: Recent passport-size photograph in colour, 80% face (without mask) visible including ears, against white background; clearly legible. A separate LIVE photograph is additionally required at form fill (webcam or mobile via QR code). No pixel/cm dimensions or DPI stated in the bulletin.

signature_spec.rules: Clearly legible; no ink, paper or dimension rules stated in the bulletin.

source_title: Information Bulletin – 2026, National Testing Agency (Joint Entrance Examination (Main) – 2026)

en.intro: Use this IBPS workspace to prepare an image copy while keeping your source file unchanged. Photo framing and signature fitting are handled separately. Check the notification for the application you are completing before entering any size or format values.

cycle: IBPS CRP PO/MT-XVI and CRP CSA 2026
name: IBPS
notes: Photo and signature specs are identical between CRP PO/MT and CRP CSA guidelines (both read directly from official ibps.in PDFs); kept as a single IBPS record. The CRP PO/MT-XVI detailed-notification link returned HTTP 500; its Annexure III specs are corroborated by the guidelines PDFs.

photo_spec.rules: Dimensions stated as preferred (200 x 230 pixels), not mandatory; scanner minimum 200 DPI, True Colour. Recent passport-style colour picture (4.5 cm x 3.5 cm); look straight at the camera; no caps/hats/dark glasses; religious headwear allowed if the face is not covered.

signature_spec.rules: Dimensions stated as preferred (140 x 60 pixels). Sign on white paper with black ink pen; must be the applicant's own signature; signature in CAPITAL LETTERS is not accepted; mismatch with the exam-day signature leads to disqualification.

source_title: Guidelines for scanning and Uploading Documents (CRP CSA application portal, ibps.in)

en.intro: A legible signature and a clearly framed portrait need different editing decisions for an SBI PO application. Read the cycle and source shown below, then use the matching editor. Preferred image dimensions, file-size limits and the application’s other document requirements must be checked together.

name: SBI PO
notes: Values from Annexure II of the official advertisement; the official careers portal is JavaScript-only so the ad text was read via three identical faithful mirror copies. sbi.co.in redirects to the current official domain sbi.bank.in.

photo_spec.rules: Dimensions stated as preferred (200 x 230 pixels); header: Photograph (4.5 cm x 3.5 cm). Scanner minimum 200 DPI, True Color. Recent passport-style colour picture; look straight at the camera; no caps/hats/dark glasses; religious headwear allowed if the face is not covered. Retain about 8 copies of the same photo for later stages. A live photograph is additionally required at form fill (webcam or mobile via QR code).

signature_spec.rules: Dimensions stated as preferred (140 x 60 pixels). Sign on white paper with black ink pen; applicant only; signature in CAPITAL LETTERS is not accepted; used on the Call Letter; mismatch at the exam leads to disqualification.

source_title: Recruitment of Probationary Officers – Advertisement No. CRPD/PO/2026-27/09, State Bank of India (Annexure II, guidelines for scanning and upload of documents)

en.intro: Match your RRB application to the recruitment cycle listed below before preparing files. Recruitment notices can use different photograph workflows. Follow any live-capture requirement in the source instructions and use the signature editor only for the file the application asks you to upload.

name: RRB
notes: Official PDF read directly. Photo handling differs from RRB ALP (see rrb-alp record); signature specs are identical in both CENs.

photo_spec.rules: No photo upload. A live photograph is captured by the application module at form fill (webcam or mobile front camera). Do NOT upload a pre-existing photograph — applications doing so face summary rejection. Dress in dark non-white clothing; no cap/mask/glasses; preview and retake until submission.

signature_spec.rules: Dimensions stated as minimums (minimum 140 pixels width x 60 pixels height). JPG/JPEG only. Minimum 100 DPI scan. Sign with black ink pen on white paper; running/cursive handwriting — NOT block, capital or disjointed letters; signed by the candidate only; centered within the 35 mm (w) x 20 mm (h) scan box; must match signatures captured at exams, DV, Medical and Appointment.

source_title: Centralised Employment Notification (CEN) No. 09/2025 – Recruitment for Various Posts in Level 1 of 7th CPC Pay Matrix, Railway Recruitment Boards

en.intro: RRB Assistant Loco Pilot applications need a scanned photograph upload with stated pixel minimums and file-size limits, unlike the live-capture flow used for Level-1 posts. The table below records the official CEN 01/2025 specifications.

name: RRB ALP
notes: Official PDF read directly. Separate record because photo specs differ from RRB Level-1 (ALP requires a scanned photo upload; Level-1 captures a live photo). CEN 01/2025 is the latest ALP notice.

photo_spec.rules: Dimensions stated as minimums (minimum 240 pixels width x 320 pixels height). Colour Indian passport-size photograph 35 mm (w) x 45 mm (h); scanned at minimum 150 DPI; plain white background only; head must occupy at least 50% of the photograph; forehead, both eyes, both cheeks, nose, chin, neck and both shoulders clearly visible; no sun/dark glasses, no cap/hat; no signature/name/date marks on the photo; not older than 2 months from the closing date; keep at least 12 copies for DV/Medical.

signature_spec.rules: Dimensions stated as minimums (minimum 140 pixels width x 60 pixels height). JPG/JPEG only. Minimum 100 DPI scan. Sign with black ink pen on white paper; running handwriting — NOT block, capital or disjointed letters; complete signature visible, centered within the 35 mm (w) x 20 mm (h) scan box; signed by the applicant only.

source_title: Centralised Employment Notice (CEN) No. 01/2025 – Recruitment of Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP), Railway Recruitment Boards

en.intro: This KCET workspace helps you turn an existing photo or signature image into a separate upload copy. Review the current instructions first, enter the required values, and inspect the result before submitting it. Your files stay in your browser throughout the editing process.

name: KCET
notes: The official KEA bulletin PDF returned HTTP 500, so it could not be read from the official domain. A verbatim mirror copy of the same bulletin file was full-text searched: no pixel dimensions, no file-size limits and no formats are stated anywhere for photo or signature uploads (the bulletin only asks candidates to retain 2–3 copies of the uploaded photo). Specs appear only in the live application form; all fields stay null until a readable official source is found.
source_title: KEA E-Information Bulletin-1, COMMON ENTRANCE TEST – 2026 (dated 16-01-2026)

en.intro: Check both appearance and file properties when preparing a GATE photograph or signature. A file can meet a byte limit while still needing a different crop. This page brings the editable image and its specification table together without claiming unverified official requirements.

name: GATE
notes: Official brochure read directly (cross-checked against gate2027.iitm.ac.in/guideline). File-size minima are NOT stated — only maxima (600 KB photo / 300 KB signature), so min_kb is null. Pixel dimensions and aspect ratios are ranges, recorded in rules.

photo_spec.rules: Pixel resolution is a range, not fixed values: minimum 200 x 260 px, maximum 530 x 690 px (aspect ratio 0.66–0.89). Physical size 3.5 cm (w) x 4.5 cm (h). No minimum file size stated in the brochure — only the 600 KB maximum. Face covering 30–35% pre-crop, 60–70% after cropping; frontal view; forehead, eyes, nose and chin visible; no caps, hats, sunglasses or coloured glasses (plain spectacles OK unless glare); head coverings only for religious reasons.

signature_spec.rules: Pixel resolution is a range: minimum 250 x 80 px, maximum 580 x 180 px; aspect ratio (height:width) 1:R with R between 2.75 and 3.75; signature area must cover 70–80% of the image after cropping. No minimum file size stated — only the 300 KB maximum. Black or dark blue ink only; applicant's own signature; mismatch with exam-day signature can lead to disqualification.

source_title: GATE 2027 Information Brochure (revised version, dated 27 September 2026), §6.7 Photograph and Signature Requirements — IIT Madras
